name: Phong BRDF Model
definition: A parametric surface reflectance model used in differentiable rendering to optimize material properties (roughness, albedo, specular) by computing gradients of a loss function with respect to $k_d$, $k_s$, and $\alpha$.
summary: The Phong BRDF Model is a parametric surface reflectance model distinguished by its explicit parameterization for differentiable rendering, enabling gradient-based optimization of material properties.
